build: plugged (the robot on the bench supply, 2026-10-19: as built 2026-10-15 (bench box, two XL4015 + 5991) with the Pi Zero W replaced by the Radxa Cubie A7Z and the AC019 antenna in the head cap; Camera Module 3 entry kept (the fitted Radxa Camera 13M 214 is of the same order, not weighed); the bench box's rear lid with its four M2 x 10 is on since 2026-10-26 (Shawn); since 2026-10-26 the A7Z is out of the head on the roof saddle (Shawn): board, header and antenna moved to trunk_base, the saddle added: V1.35 body (D-028 V3, lid not fitted) with the A7Z screwed to the Radxa 6530B (Shawn 2026-10-26: 鞍座是1.35, 盖没有盖), the Pi-era board screws and the CSI ribbon out of the head, and the IMU, UART, 5 V and amplifier leads re-run to the saddle header from the guide routes; the U20CAM lead rides stiff above the neck and the saddle (Shawn 2026-10-26)). Derived by cmu/model/make_variants.py from cmu/model/variants/plugged.json on top of cmu/whole/dynamics/asbuilt-20261015/asbuilt-mass-manifest.json; do not edit, edit the variant file and rerun.
frame: official MJCF body frames, m; guide geometry mapped from trunk_base qpos0 frame
excluded: BNO085 zip ties on the V1.8 shelf (< 0.3 g)
NP-F970 battery: removed by the runner through remove_old_battery_kg (assumption sweep)
Community printed rings vs official seeed bearings, neck_pitch_ring, neck shims: unchanged or < 1 g
Threaded inserts: none in the guide screw list (all screws are self-tapping TAP)

Not fitted: orange V1.9 clips (clip_torso, clip_bracket, clip_head, clip_cap, 1.25 g together) and their screws (Shawn 2026-10-14: small orange V1.9 parts not installed); MAX98357A GAIN resistor (dropped, D-008)

Not fitted yet: Radxa Cubie A7Z, Radxa Camera 13M 214, AC019 antenna, V1.17 A7Z head cap/face/clip (D-011: arrive 2026-10-16); XIAO ESP32-S3 touch board and copper pads (D-013: not bought); battery backpack (D-010: cart unpaid); XT30/MR30 swap plugs (D-010 plan, not in the bench-box chapters)
V2.0 side shells and thighs (V1.17 White plate, printed 2026-10-15): fitting not recorded; the official shell and thigh masses stay in the MJCF bodies
Bench tethers beyond the robot (USB-C PD cable into the 5991, OpenRB USB data cable): not modelled; their drag is not simulated
NP-F970 battery: removed by apply_masses.variant_parts (battery_removal_part, 90 g) for every variant, not listed here
